Class ARepoMySQL

java.lang.Object
app.repository.ARepoMySQL
All Implemented Interfaces:
AssetRepository
public class ARepoMySQL extends Object implements AssetRepository
MySQL repo for AssetRepository connects the Database to the Repo which we call upon to save all asset info into the DB not the InMemory Repo
